sources.title: Terms of Service
rules: Uploader must own or have all necessary rights, consents and permissions
Uploads must comply with the original game's terms
Uploader grants Nexus and its partners the upload licences described in section 24
Automated scraping/text-data mining of Nexus content is prohibited without exemption

sources.title: File Submission Guidelines
rules: Credit is not a substitute for permission
Compilations must add functionality beyond repackaging
Public files must be functional, accurately described, correctly categorised and truthfully claimed

sources.title: Adult Content Guidelines
rules: Adult and extreme content must be classified and tagged accurately

sources.title: Donation Points System Rules
rules: Donation Points require original work or each included asset to be cleared for that use

sources.title: Best Practices for Mod Authors
rules: Provide requirements, installation instructions, versioning and mod-manager-friendly packaging

sources.title: Nexus Mods 25th Anniversary Mod Drive Guidelines
rules: Event submissions prohibit generative AI for assets, code or dialogue
Event submissions must meet its date, violence, branding and rights rules

automation_boundary: Forge must not scrape Nexus Mods. Permission and policy evidence is user supplied or obtained through an authorized API workflow.
legal_boundary: Machine checks cannot authenticate ownership, consent, trademark clearance, privacy rights or jurisdiction-specific legality. The uploader remains responsible.
